libs.note: BH-6485. A ticket body names `Spec: <path>#<section>`, `Reference: <path>` and `Cut: <token>` lines; the plan gate, the general review lens, preview QA and the PR self-check check the slice against them. Resolved by st_conf through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then the env, then the ST_DEFAULT_* values in bin/lib/spec-trace.sh, which equal the defaults here (tests/plan-spec-trace.bh-6485-test.sh K1). bin/reference-shots.sh reads the REFERENCE_SHOTS_* knobs through the same st_conf.

knobs.note: 1: a plan with an untraced named section or an unlisted Reference is refused (rc 2, the plan gate's repair pass, then PLAN_MALFORMED), and a general-lens APPROVE with an untraced section or an uncut missing/contradicts row becomes a BLOCK. 0: both write a log line only. Applies only to tickets whose body carries Spec:/Reference: lines.
Byte cap on one spec section the review note carries verbatim. A longer section is cut and the note says `[truncated at N bytes]`.
Byte cap on all the spec sections in one review note. A section past it is named `NOT INCLUDED` with its path, so the reviewer reads the file.
Retention of the `harness-shots/<key>-<yyyymmdd>` side branches bin/reference-shots.sh pushes. A branch whose date is older than this is a prune candidate.
dry | on | off. dry (default) logs the prune candidates and deletes none; on deletes up to REFERENCE_SHOTS_PRUNE_MAX per run; off does nothing. One audit line per run in logs/reference-shots.log.
How many expired harness-shots/* branches one prune run deletes when REFERENCE_SHOTS_PRUNE=on.
